params.body:
Characterization tests for the price every screen shows today, warts included. **No behaviour changed**: this PR adds two test classes and five rows to the findings table. No production file is touched.

The clean-up planned after the cutover is what this net is for: `App\Support\CustomerModePrice` unified the arithmetic this afternoon, and the places where the screens still disagree are now written down as amounts rather than as intentions.

## The matrix walked

| | |
|---|---|
| **screens** | stocklist card, index card, buybox (detail), lease block, offer modal, order modal price field, order modal lease row, order/offer document, showroom slide, dealer website card, website lease calculator, public API |
| **vehicles** | a VAT vehicle (trade 10 000 incl. 21%) and a margin vehicle |
| **viewer** | the owner, a colleague at the same rate, a colleague at 6% while the viewer is at 21%, and nobody signed in |
| **customer mode** | off; on; on without a margin; a session carrying `client_mode = 'false'` with a leftover margin; a session carrying a value that is neither (`'0'`) |
| **exceptions** | the viewer's own vehicle, a sold vehicle on the detail page, R S5-4.6 (a price typed for one vehicle) |

Round numbers throughout — trade 10 000, margin 500, retail 12 000, 21% VAT — so every expectation is a number a person can check (`10 500,00`), never a re-computation of the formula.

**`tests/Unit/PriceScreenMatrixTest.php`** (18 cases, no database): every row of the matrix against `CustomerModePrice`, one assertion per screen, written out as amounts.

**`tests/Feature/PriceOnScreenTest.php`** (21 cases, real models): what actually reaches the HTML. Rendered through their real route or view: the order/offer document (`price_calulation`, via `OfferPricing`), the offer modal, the order modal, the detail page (buybox and lease block, read back with a regex on `js-sticky-prijs` and on the lease field), the stocklist card (through `StocklistBrowser`), the showroom slide, the website card, and the public API. Plus the cross-rate conversion pinned against real dealers and countries, which is the only place `trade_price_incl_dealer_vat` actually fires.

## Screens reached, and one note

All of them. One correction to the brief: `stocklist/_tabs/flexlease.blade.php` no longer carries VAT handling of its own — this afternoon's unification moved it to `CustomerModePrice::leaseBase()`, and the same is true of the showroom slide (`showroomPrice`). Neither view does arithmetic any more; both were still rendered here, because both still *format* (the slide drops the cents) and the lease block still disagrees with the page around it.

Not covered, deliberately: the lease AMOUNT itself (`FlexleaseController::fetchPrice` calls a third party, sealed outside production — only the vehicle value the block sends is pinned), and the SQL twin `PublicWebsitePrice::sql()` used for sorting and facets, which is a second expression of the same rule and deserves its own test that the two agree. Recorded below as the open point.

## Disagreements found — the valuable part

Five, all pinned on both sides and written up as **X-104 … X-108** in `docs/bedrijfsregels/90-x-bevindingen.md`. None is fixed here.

1. **X-104** — R S5-4.3 says the dealer price is nowhere visible in customer mode. In the price blocks it is not; the detail page still carries it **twice in the page source**: the customer-mode modal holds it as the hint of R S5-4.6, and the buy-over confirmation string is built into the page whether or not its button is shown. One view-source away.
2. **X-105** — on one detail page, one vehicle, two prices: with `client_mode = 'false'` and a leftover margin the buybox shows **10 000** (strict reading) while the lease field below it carries **10 500** (bare-key reading).
3. **X-106** — the order modal shows two amounts for one own vehicle: **12 000** in the price field (`orderPrefill`, per R S5-4.5) and **10 500** in its own lease row (`documentPrefill`, which never asks whose vehicle it is). The offer modal beside it puts **10 500** in its price field for the same reason, so R S5-4.5 does not hold there at all.
4. **X-107** — a `client_mode` value that is neither `'true'` nor `'false'` pulls the three readings apart completely: card and buybox show 10 000, both modals pre-fill 10 500, the lease block computes on 10 500. Cleaning this up needs a count of what `client_mode` actually holds in production first.
5. **X-108** — without a margin setting the dealer's website says "op aanvraag" and the showroom slide of that same dealer prints the **colleague's trade price** to the street. Both public, both without a signed-in user, opposite answers.

One thing checked and found **not** to be a defect: the order document of a margin vehicle prints every step (discount, advance, takeover) just like a VAT vehicle — it only swaps the exclusive column for "alles inbegrepen". Pinned as such.

## Rules

Every test carries the `@rule` it covers: S1-5.5, S1-5.7, S4-3.9 … S4-3.12, S2-7.6, S5-4.1 … S5-4.12, P3-3.10. S5 coverage goes from 21% to 40%. No new rules were added: every screen behaviour found is described by a rule that already exists, which is why the gaps became findings instead.

## Open point

`PublicWebsitePrice::sql()` is the price rule written a second time, in SQL, for filtering, sorting and facets on the website and the public API. Nothing proves the two expressions agree. A test that computes both for the same vehicles and compares belongs with this net, and is not in this PR.

## Verification

```
php artisan test --filter='Price|Prijs|CustomerMode|Klantmodus|Offer|Stocklist|Website|PublicVehicle|Showroom|Flexlease|RulesCoverage'
OK (167 tests, 716 assertions)
```

`bin/rules-coverage` exits 0. `docs/bedrijfsregels.html` and `docs/bedrijfsregels/92-testdekking-tabel.md` are generated and gitignored; neither is in this commit.
params.title: Prices: tests for what each screen already shows
